summary: OMA furnished a routine Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign issuer current report) disclosing October 2026 passenger traffic, not a special situation. Terminal traffic at its 13 Mexican airports fell 4.8% year over year, with domestic down 6.5% and international up 5.9%; commercial traffic was 99.5% of the total and general aviation 0.5%. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or transaction mechanic is disclosed. The release reiterates that OMA has been part of VINCI Airports since December 2022. Watch monthly traffic trends and the VINCI ownership overhang rather than deal terms.
